description: This file defines a data model class 'Seat' representing a seat in a seating arrangement, including its properties and a copyWith method for immutability.

classes.name: Seat
classes.description: A class modeling a seat with its identifier, position (row and column), and reservation status.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Seat instance with optional override of the 'isReserved' status.
